mapper.sql: F.FCLTY_SN, F.FCLTY_TY_CD, C.CODE_NM AS FCLTY_TY_NM, F.FCLTY_NM, F.ADRES, F.ACMD_NMPR, F.OPER_BEGIN_TM, F.OPER_END_TM, F.RESVE_UNIT_MIN, F.FCLTY_DC, F.USE_YN, F.REGISTER_ID, F.REGIST_DT, F.UPDUSR_ID, F.UPDT_DT
FROM TB_FCLTY F LEFT JOIN TB_CMMN_CODE C ON C.CODE_ID = 'FCLTY_TY' AND C.CODE = F.FCLTY_TY_CD
mapper.insert: SELECT SEQ_FCLTY.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO TB_FCLTY (FCLTY_SN, FCLTY_TY_CD, FCLTY_NM, ADRES, ACMD_NMPR, OPER_BEGIN_TM, OPER_END_TM, RESVE_UNIT_MIN, FCLTY_DC, USE_YN, REGISTER_ID, REGIST_DT) VALUES (#{fcltySn}, #{fcltyTyCd}, #{fcltyNm}, #{adres}, #{acmdNmpr}, #{operBeginTm}, #{operEndTm}, #{resveUnitMin}, #{fcltyDc}, #{useYn}, #{registerId}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_FCLTY SET FCLTY_TY_CD = #{fcltyTyCd}, FCLTY_NM = #{fcltyNm}, ADRES = #{adres}, ACMD_NMPR = #{acmdNmpr}, OPER_BEGIN_TM = #{operBeginTm}, OPER_END_TM = #{operEndTm}, RESVE_UNIT_MIN = #{resveUnitMin}, FCLTY_DC = #{fcltyDc}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPDUSR_ID = #{updusrId}, UPDT_DT = SYSDATE WHERE FCLTY_SN = #{fcltySn}
